tasks.details:
Create a central, deterministic runtime loop that orchestrates all agent activity. This loop becomes the “brainstem” of the Agent OS, coordinating the planner, router, tool supervisor, memory system, hooks, and CPU.

The runtime loop should:
- Initialize AgentState (messages, scratchpad, memory deltas, last tool result, step counter, halted flag)
- Enter a step-by-step execution cycle
- On each iteration: run pre-step hooks, invoke Planner, pass through Rule Layer, handle LLM/Tool/Final Answer actions, run post-step hooks, emit bus events, increment step counter
- Enforce deterministic safety rules (max steps, max tool retries, no hallucinated tools, no invalid JSON, no infinite loops)
- Integrate with memory (write deltas, update episodic + semantic memory, trigger memory hooks)
- Terminate cleanly on halt, error, or max steps reached
